definitions.explanation: Having no selfish desires or ambition. Describes a person or attitude that is not driven by personal gain. Generally a positive quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無欲|むよく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{無欲|むよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{尊敬|そんけい}→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Her selfless dedication to work is respected by those around her.

examples.japanese: {無欲|むよく}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、かえって⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Being free from greed can actually produce good results.

notes:
USAGE:
{無欲|むよく} is generally used as a positive descriptor, suggesting purity of intention and lack of selfish motives. It can function as a na-adjective ({無欲|むよく}な) or as a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無欲|むよく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a selfless person)
- {無欲|むよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ (to live without greed)
- {無欲|むよく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧ (a victory achieved without attachment to winning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{欲張|よくば}り→欲張り：15920_yokubari⟧ is the opposite — a greedy person. {無私|むし} means selfless or disinterested and is more literary. ⟦{淡泊|たんぱく}→淡泊：07906_tanpaku⟧ means indifferent or detached, with a more neutral tone.
